ablation.name: brk_v_train_adain
ablation.notes: Round 5 Direction 2: Train-time AdaIN alignment. Math: endpoint_adain_scale=1.0 at inference creates train-test mismatch. Training target x1* is raw SAT, but inference output is AdaIN(ODE(v_theta), x_s). Enabling train_adain makes training target = AdaIN(x1*, x_s, alpha=1.0), aligning distributions. Expected: CLIP-S recovery (mismatch eliminated), DINO-S maintained.
